gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-anek-telugu: Wobbly, goofy, almost sealed shut. Jelly Crazies keeps its bowls pinched closed and its strokes unthinned, while Anek Telugu leaves its tall rounds open like an unlatched hook, so the plain sans body gives the eye somewhere to breathe.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-georgia: Retro, chunky, pinched at the curves. Junegull is best at making cast-iron lowercase look friendly with its narrow mouths, while Noto Sans Georgian does its best work in open apertures and short ascenders, a sans-serif that stays out of the way.
